_what: Study 2's settings. Every rule in RUN.md that depends on the network or the clock reads its value here. A change is a dated commit to this file, recorded in LEDGER.md, before the next job runs.

home._what: The home-network arm (phase 3 and history priming). Scanned only inside the window, on the mini's own clock.

testbed._what: The virtual network inside the mini (phases 1 and 2). Never leaves the machine, so it runs at any time.

clock._what: No zone is fixed: the window is in whatever zone the mini is set to. Every job records the zone name and UTC offset it ran in. A home job is refused if the offset would change while it runs (a daylight-saving night, in any zone) or if NTP is off by more than the limit.
